Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. When you do, reveal as many cards from your deck as is possible.
Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's effect when I have 3 or fewer cards in my deck?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal 4 cards from the top of your deck. Add all yellow Tamer cards among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
